# Oxygen UI rules

Rule set version 0.0.1.

## Rules

| Rule | Category | Level | Severity | Enforcement | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`no-direct-mui-imports`](src/rules/no-direct-mui-imports/docs.md): Import MUI components from Oxygen UI | imports | mandatory | error | automated | safe |
| [`no-direct-lucide-imports`](src/rules/no-direct-lucide-imports/docs.md): Import icons from Oxygen UI icons | imports | mandatory | error | automated | safe |
